title: Kryeit: Cake Edition
description: A fanmade Modpack for the modded Minecraft server, Kryeit.
body:
A custom modpack for the Kryeit server, made after a joke with friends.

The Original Modpack can be found [here](https://modrinth.com/modpack/kryeit)

 This version of the modpack includes a custom Resource pack, thus the name; Cake Edition. It also includes addon mods, such as; Chat Heads, Chest Tracker, and multiple performance mods.

I am not with the Kryeit team, this is just a fan project made for the bit. Thank you to Muri and the Original creators of Kryeit for creating such a modpack!

Much love -P.C.
